name: Dinks & Delights Pickleball Day
blurb: The Bazaar teams up with The Pickleball Shack SRQ for live demos and free beginner lessons in the Rosemary District. Live music runs alongside the courts, with local shops to browse and food and drink from Hamlet's Eatery. Admission is free.

name: The Great Scallop Search
venue: Sarasota Sailing Squadron (Aug 22) / Mar Vista, Longboat Key (Aug 23)
blurb: Sarasota Bay Watch's annual citizen-science day puts volunteers on the water to tally bay scallops before returning them to the flats. Sign on as a boat captain, snorkeler, kayaker or crew: no experience needed and it is free to join. Teams launch from the Sarasota Sailing Squadron on City Island Saturday and from Mar Vista on Longboat Key Sunday.

name: Summer Art Mart at Art Ovation
blurb: More than 30 local artists set up inside downtown's Art Ovation Hotel with jewelry, ceramics, glass and paintings. Browsing is free and drinks are available while you make the rounds. RSVP is required through the hotel.

name: Midsummer Night Music Festival: Sarasota Piano Trio
blurb: The Sarasota Piano Trio returns to St. Armands Key Lutheran Church with a program of rediscovered chamber music gems. Tickets run $10 to $30 and cover either in-person seating or the live stream. An easy walk from St. Armands Circle.
source: Your Observer / St. Armands Key Lutheran Church
